item.title: Susan Miller is March Artist of the Month
item.description: The West Volusia Artists are promoting Susan Miller as the March Artist of the Month, and her featured artwork is Sunken Treasure Hidden Picture. item.title: Breakfast Rotary turns 50
item.description: Members of the DeLand Breakfast Rotary Club assembled at the March 2 DeLand City Commission meeting to join the city in celebrating the club’s 50th anniversary. DeLand has four Rotary clubs. The oldest is the Rotary Club of DeLand, sometimes called the Noon Rotary, which was organized in December 1926, and is on the verge of celebrating its centennial. item.title: Cassadaga will get a sunflower mural
item.description: A sunflower mural is scheduled to bloom this spring on the historic Andrew Jackson Davis Educational Building at 1112 Stevens St. in the Cassadaga Spiritualist Camp. Artist Sunshine Okubo, a 56-year-old muralist from Alachua County, will begin work March 11, with completion expected by March 18.
